title: First meeting: discovery, not a funnel to a build
persona: An owner whose returns take hours; explains when asked, never asks for a build.

facts.how returns happen: Customers WhatsApp me, I check the order, ask for photos, then book a pickup
facts.the slow part: Finding the order and checking photos

success: Luke asks how returns happen today before suggesting anything
Luke says back what it understood before probing further
Luke asks who does the slow part or which part is slow
must_not: a design or a build offered before they ask for one
